# EduCore

EduCore is a comprehensive school management system for administrators, teachers, students, and parents.

## Features
- Student management and enrollment
- Grade tracking and report cards
- Fee management and M-Pesa reconciliation
- Attendance tracking
- Timetable and exam management
- HR and staff management
- Library and discipline management
- Financial reporting and analytics
